subject: coalesced CPU/SIMD small-lane topology allocation ownership

measurement.method: counting global allocator around the production topology builder and its legacy per-lane ownership reference

legacy.ownership: one small-index staging vector, one lane descriptor vector, and one vector per small lane

candidate.ownership: one flat small-index vector and one lane descriptor vector

limit: The receipt measures topology-construction allocations at the production builder choke point. It does not claim a 21x whole-scan wall-time improvement or allocator-internal retained-memory behavior.
